newsitem.title: TAIWAN: CPC to build residue fluid catalytic cracker.
newsitem.headline: CPC to build residue fluid catalytic cracker.

text.p: Taiwan state oil monopoly Chinese Petroleum Corp said on Monday it would build a 50,000 barrel-per-day residue fluid catalytic cracker project at its northern Taoyuan refinery.
Chinese Petroleum has invited bids for the project and the initial qualification review of the bidders will close on August 28, officials said.
Chinese Petroleum required bidders to use the process technology of Exxon Research and Engineering Company, a unit of Exxon Corp, to build the cracker, officials said.
Other details of the project were not immediately available.
Qualified bidders will be invited to join price bidding for the project, but no exact date has been set for such bidding.
The Taoyuan refinery produces 60,000 tonnes of jet fuel a month at full capacity, mainly supplying the nearby Taipei international airport.
